defect: shift-register FIFO loop indexing can resemble an off-end write
rationale: The shift loop runs only while i is less than DEPTH-1, so i+1 is at most DEPTH-1. The count width can represent DEPTH, and m_data is irrelevant when m_valid is false.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the SRL FIFO to its count, shift loop, and ready/valid control while retaining the source's array indexing structure.

mutation.description: A parameterized shift loop writes data_reg[i+1] under a bound that proves the index remains inside the FIFO.
